# vastdata_cnode_bgp_config (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_cnode_bgp_config" "vastdb_cnode_bgp_config" {
  cnode_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cnode_id` (Number) ID of the Cnode

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable BGP
- `port1_peer_address` (String) Port1 peer address
- `port1_self_address` (String) Port1 self address
- `port2_peer_address` (String) Port2 peer address
- `port2_self_address` (String) Port2 self address
- `self_asn` (String) ASN
- `subnet_bits` (Number) Subnet bits
